title: 5 weekly habits that keep a freight brokerage moving
seoTitle: 5 weekly habits that keep a freight brokerage moving
searchIntent: What should a freight broker review every week?
excerpt: A weekly review for customer activity, prospect follow-up, professional connections, agent support and time away from the desk.
takeaway: Review existing customers, build relevant connections, follow up with prospects, support your agents and schedule time away. A busy week should leave the business stronger, not just the inbox emptier.

sections.title: What should a freight broker review every week?
paragraphs: Start with the customers already trusting you with freight. In this lesson, Luis recommends looking for changes in their activity before chasing another entirely new account. A customer who used to send regular work and has gone quiet deserves a conversation.

Ask what changed. Production might be slower, a lane may have moved, or your service may have fallen short. The load count tells you where to look; the customer tells you what happened. Use that conversation to decide the next action.

sections.title: Build connections with a reason to talk
paragraphs: Set aside time to find people at companies you understand. A relevant professional connection gives you a place to begin a conversation about their freight. Sending requests to everyone with a shipping title gives you a larger list without necessarily giving you better opportunities.
Keep a brief note on each company: what it ships, where it operates and why your service could help. That preparation makes the next exchange easier for both people.

sections.title: Follow up and support the team
paragraphs: Review prospects with open conversations, outstanding quotes or an agreed date to reconnect. Follow up on the actual discussion. A useful message answers a question or moves a decision forward; repeating your introduction does neither.

Luis also recommends individual check-ins with agents. Ask about quote response, wins, lost opportunities and the support they need. If someone is struggling, find the specific obstacle before telling them to make more calls.

sections.title: Give recovery a place on the calendar
paragraphs: The fifth habit is time away from freight. Luis talks about getting ideas while cooking, exercising or doing something outside the office. You still need coverage for active commitments, but being permanently exhausted is not an operating plan.
Finish your review with one customer action, one prospect action and one improvement for the team. Schedule those actions, along with time to recover, so the review changes the coming week.
